text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGER fired: 5xx error-rate spike detected for service `inference-gateway-prod` in us-west1. 5xx_rate = 6.2% over 60s (threshold 3%). PagerDuty incident created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2103

pagerduty: Incident INC-2103 triggered and notified on-call. Escalation policy: inference-prod-oncall -> eng-sre.

sara (oncall): acked. I'm looking now — heading to logs/metrics.

david: joining — grabbing proxy and model-backend logs.

ash (ops-bot): auto-escalation to david after 30s (policy). :timer_clock: 

ash (ml-oncall): saw a similar blip last week that was a KV cache stall causing backend timeouts. Check redis/kv eviction and model-backend connection resets.

jonah (eng-sre): checking HPA / node utilization. If pods are stuck terminating we might be hitting connection saturation.

David: running quick checks now:
```bash
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-gateway --since=2m | egrep "5..|error|timeout" | tail -n 200
```

David: logs show lots of 502s proxied from model-backend: "upstream prematurely closed connection" and repeated "connection reset by peer" entries. Model-backend pods are OOMKilled recently?

ash (ops-bot): digging into node events... one node in us-west1-b had kubelet OOM events ~90s ago. Could be noisy GC / memory leak in a model shard.

ash (ops-bot): redis/kv metrics look okay (no high latency), but model-backend CPU spikes concurrently.

ash (ml-oncall): could also be kernel selection regression in recent runtime kernel set. Any recent deploys?

David: checking deploy history -> last deploy to model-backend at 2103456600 (10m ago). Rolling restart started then.

sara (oncall): can we throttle or route traffic away from us-west1 while we investigate? Customer impact: some chat/llm responses failing with 5xx, but embeddings look fine. CS pinged.

eva-cs: we have 3 customers reporting increased errors in product. Two are using hosted API endpoint in us-west. They're asking ETA.

jonah (eng-sre): temporary mitigation plan: 1) reduce traffic weight to us-west1 in traffic-router by 50%, 2) scale up model-backend replica count (if HPA not reacting), 3) rollback last model-backend deploy if issues persist.

David: executing scale up now:
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/model-backend --replicas=12
kubectl -n prod get hpa model-backend -o yaml
```

ops-bot: scale command accepted. model-backend replicas -> 12. :white_check_mark: 

David: also seeing restart loops on one model-backend pod (model-backend-7f6c9). Dumping pod describe...

David: pod describe shows OOMKilled reasons and repeated preStop hooks taking too long. Investigating container memory limit.

ash (ml-oncall): try reducing batch size / concurrency on that model shard via runtime flags to reduce mem pressure. We can patch config and rollout.

David: applied a quick patch to runtime config to reduce max_concurrency to 8 for the problematic variant. Rolling update initiated.

incident-bot: Automated alert suppression applied for noisy 5xx alert group while on-call investigating.

sara (oncall): rerouting 50% traffic away — router config updated (canary weights): us-west1 50% -> other regions 50%. Links: https://internal.router/traffic/inference-gateway

jonah (eng-sre): monitoring error rate after scale and config change. If 5xx drops below 1% for 5m we consider stabilised.

David: after scaling + config patch, 5xx rate dropped to 1.4% (1m) and to 0.8% (3m). OOM restarts stopped on that pod.

eva-cs: telling customers we mitigated and investigating root cause; ETA for full recovery TBD.

ash (ml-oncall): leaving a rollback option in case config patch causes regression. Patch id: cfg-2103-reduce-concurrency.

sara (oncall): acked by me in PD. I'll keep monitoring for 20m, then hand off to next oncall with notes. Please add any postmortem links to the PD incident.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2103 acknowledged by sara (oncall). Current status: mitigated (partial) — follow-up required (postmortem, config review).

jonah (eng-sre): create a follow-up ticket to audit memory limits and preStop behavior on model-backend pods; suggest increasing readiness probe timeout and look at GC tuning.

David: opening ticket now: https://tracker/redwood/ISSUE-4591 "model-backend OOM & preStop hang during rollout" assigned to eng-infra.

sara (oncall): closing this Slack thread — will ping handoff channel in 15m and file postmortem request. Thanks all. :pray: 

ops-bot: auto-note: temporary suppressions removed after 30m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2103 status updated to "stabilized" in PagerDuty. Follow-up: postmortem requested.
